meaning:
ἐκ-πληρόω
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:10, 3Ma.1:2 3Mac 1:22 * ;]
1. to fill full, make up a number.
2. to fulfil (MM, Exp., xii; Cremer, 839), Act.13:32.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become…
